title: What Quorum Replication Internals Is All About
description: Majority rules: how quorums give consistency without a leader.. This database covers Quorum Replication Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Replication is copying data for durability, availability, or scale.
definition: Quorum Replication Internals — Majority rules: how quorums give consistency without a leader.

Leader-follower is the default; simple to reason about.
